label: Bible Study
prompt: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a _____ heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
verse: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
note: David learned the one sacrifice God always accepts is a broken and contrite heart.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it _____.
verse: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
note: Worry weighs a heart down, but a good word maketh it glad — which is the whole idea of this game.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying _____.
verse: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.
note: Heaven's four creatures: a lion, a calf, a man's face, and a flying eagle — Ezekiel saw them too (Ezekiel 1:10).

label: Deep Water
prompt: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before _____, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
verse: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
note: Moments after 'Judge not,' Jesus adds discernment: don't hand holy treasure to those who'll only trample it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Thy _____ waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
verse: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
note: Forty years in the desert and their 'raiment waxed not old' — no worn-out clothes, no swollen feet. Wilderness miracles.
